body:
Build brief. Rules and models approved by Karolis 30-31 Oct.
MODELS: backyard levels 1, 2, 3 all picked. L1 empty first; items appear as bought. L2: play corner, no pond. L3: front = garden + everyday pets; back = big-pet area the whole lot wide (seal pond ~4.3x3.9 m, monkey tree ~3x2.8 m, bear cave ~3.7x2.8 m, gate at x -12.4, stone path).
ONLY OWNED SHOWS (rules-yard-only-owned): the level gives space (fence, gate, path, grass); homes, pens, ponds, trees, beds, toys, bowls appear only once bought. No locked pot plates: today all 30 pots show '🔒 Level N' (js/02-world.js YARD_POTS); they appear only when unlocked. Pots players have stay. Yard levels never limit how many pets you keep (10). Dog houses already placed as furniture stay.
LEVELS (rules-garden-levels, rules-q-yard-skill): pet yard L2 at Pet care 20, L3 at Pet care 40. Garden L2 at gardening 20, L3 at 40: each adds 3 beds at the back, open when bought (save spots 36-41), plus more space and nicer looks. Training gear: small gear at pet yard L1, agility course at L2. Pots keep Izabele's rule (idea 75, gardening 10-50).
CARE: home bowl + toys = home pets lose needs at half speed; pets nap near you; bear and seal nap in their own home (den, pond).
Game work: per-lot hedge step-back; 6 beds + 30 pot spots unchanged; 6 new beds in the back strip.
MOVES: moves-pet-yard-gear (pets on gear and agility course).
SCREENS: screens-yard-sign (sign by your yard sells garden and pet yard levels).
PLACEMENTS: project doc claude/pfu-placements.json (Friends Lane border 37.5 for the wider level-3 yard, entry map-lane-border).
PRICES (economy-pfu-prices, approved): pet yard L1 free, L2 800 (Pet care 20), L3 2,000 (Pet care 40); garden L1 free, L2 600 (Gardening 20), L3 1,500 (Gardening 40). Fence, gate, path and decoration come with the level.

comments.text: What changed: models picked; skill gates; only owned things show.

Game rules chat: updated with today's last rules (+3 beds per garden level, training gear, pet count, dog houses).
Ready for your OK.

Approved: everything in it you already decided in chat (30-31 Oct).
Recorded by the Game rules chat; Plan told.
Added: moves, screens and placements for this stage.
Plan: approved yard and garden prices added. Still approved.

short: Stage 3: yard levels by skill, +3 garden beds per level, only owned things show
